status: Accepted native local startup diagnostics display, Copy and Inspector retention on the pinned Linux cohort

cohort.producer: Public ARM64 Debian release payload. Two exact extracted AArch64 ELF64 executables ran in a temporary test runtime.

workflow.profile: Fresh isolated persistent local profile with a deliberately nonexistent public executable
workflow.Inspector_retention: After closing and reopening Inspector, the same failed tab still showed the typed snapshot. The second capture required no additional Copy.

copied_typed_snapshot.producer: The shipped Copy startup diagnostics formatter in the exact Linux GUI
copied_typed_snapshot.verification: The exact complete shipped formatter for the typed fields visible in the original screenshot yielded the same byte count and SHA-256 as the single full native read. The comparison used the original bytes without normalization.

first_observations_retained: The initial full display frame was torn. The exact owned X11 window capture replaced it as evidence without another Connect.

The first typed checker returned FORMAT_REFUSED against a mistyped starter PID of 2679627. The original Inspector shows 2676927. The exact formatter comparison above uses the single original read with no further clipboard action.
The initial final 13-file check compared integer mode to octal text. A corrected read-only comparison verified every original file.
